children: LivePerson, Inc. (NASDAQ:LPSN) said its shares converted at closing of a merger that prompted its board—including James Miller, Dan Fletcher and Nathan “Tripp” Lane—to resign and will lead Nasdaq to seek delisting while noteholders swapped debt for 36,894,839 SoundHound Class A shares (~$249M) and registered them for resale.
: LivePerson (LPSN) says its shares were converted in a merger. Nasdaq will file to delist and deregister LPSN; the company will file to suspend public reporting.
LPSN Noteholders Swap For SoundHound Shares
: LPSN noteholders swapped debt for 36,894,839 SoundHound Class A shares, registered for resale same day, valued about $249 million at the transaction price.
: LivePerson (LPSN) said its entire board, including James Miller, Dan Fletcher and Nathan “Tripp” Lane, resigned effective immediately at the Second Merger Effective Time upon merger closing.
